channel.title: Black Nerd Problems - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Black Nerd Problems (blacknerdproblems.com)

item.title: Azuki Manga Service Has a New Name: Omoi
item.description: Meaning "thought" or "feeling in Japanese, Omoi, formerly Azuki, goes through a rebrand that represents a new phase for the manga website.

item.title: Sci-Fi That Might Just Save You - BNP Interviews Jamie Mustard about His New Graphic Novel 'HYBRED'
item.description: BlackNerdProblems sits down with Jamie Mustard to discuss his new science fiction graphic novel HYBRED, and how it just might save you.

item.title: Jive Poetic Bought Slam Poetry Back to New York Comic-Con
item.description: Jive Poetic brings slam poetry back to New York Comic-Con for the second year in a row with the NYCC 2025 Poetry Slam

item.title: 'Black Defender: The Awakening' Brings a New Hero to Center Stage
item.description: Black Defender is a graphic novel created by Dr. David Washington with illustrations by Zhengis Tasbolatov.

item.title: Jay Jurden's 'Yes Ma'am' Comedy Special is Buzzer Beater Smooth
item.description: Jay Jurden's 'Yes Ma'am' serves as a beautiful reminder that comedy isn't making fun of people. It's being able to find a silver lining.

item.title: Review: 'One Battle After Another,' What Black Women Call Life
item.description: One Battle After Another is a well-told story about a revolution that endures and how we need to stay ready so you don't have to get ready.

item.title: 'Frieren' Season 2, Praise Aureole, We Back Like We Never Left
item.description: Frieren Season 2 does not get bogged down by the typical tropes of storytelling, specifically the hero's journey storytelling.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Rodney Barnes Takes on Lovecraft with 'WEIRD TALES'
item.description: Weird Tales and Monstrous bring together writers like Rodney Barnes to bring The Weird Tales Graphic Novel to readers.

item.title: An Exclusive Excerpt from 'FIRST FREEDOM: THE STORY OF OPAL LEE AND JUNETEENTH,' A Defining History of the Struggle to Recognize America’s Newest National Holiday
item.description: Discover the life of an extraordinary woman’s path through contemporary American history in First Freedom: The Story of Opal Lee and Juneteenth.

item.title: This BAFTA Shit Ain't Hard, Disability is Real, but Y'all Just Don't Care about Black Folks
item.description: BAFTA went down on February 22nd in London, and a moment took place that has brought many thoughts around disability and language.

item.title: 'PANTHEON: The Elemental Artifact' Review
item.description: All in all, this first volume of PANTHEON is solid. It was a fun read, and it is clear that the entire creative team loves mythology.
